title: Lamb Skewers with Norwegian Twist
description: A flavorful and aromatic lamb skewer recipe with a Norwegian touch, featuring quaint and delicious ingredients.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, salt, and black pepper for the marinade.
3. Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat.
4. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
5. Thread the marinated lamb onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
6. Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
7. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
8. Transfer the skewers to a plate and top with crumbled feta cheese and chopped parsley.
